title: U.S. Industries by Job Change (Sep 2025–Sep 2026)
desc: Net change in U.S. payroll employment by major industry sector from September 2025 to September 2026. Positive values indicate net jobs added; negative values indicate net jobs lost. The source uses seasonally adjusted preliminary estimates, which may be revised. This is an industry ranking, not an occupation ranking or a count of gross hires and separations.

source.name: Visual Capitalist (data: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics, Current Employment Statistics)
source.note: AllRanks assistant verified on 2026-10-23. Opened the complete Visual Capitalist article and compared all 16 major-sector rows, values, percent changes, and descending order with the BLS Employment by industry, monthly changes table for September 2026 (12-month net change, seasonally adjusted). Counts and displayed percent changes match; the BLS table reports counts in thousands to one decimal place, corresponding to the article’s nearest 100 jobs. Equal +26,500 values for wholesale and retail trade are preserved. BLS figures are preliminary and revisable. Net change is not gross hiring/separations and does not describe occupations.
